canonical_project: High-performance computing and cryptocurrency mining data centers program
owner: Ministry of Energy of Turkmenistan / foreign companies TBD
notes: Energy minister Annageldi Saparov said Turkmenistan is in preliminary negotiations with specialized international companies to develop modern data centers for high-performance computing and cryptocurrency projects using surplus electricity. Announcement was made at the White City Ashgabat 2026 conference; no project sites or capacities disclosed.
